items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we recorded during that time with ... Don Redman and the band. ... I worked with him before the war

ctx.x: band, and Don was just a beautiful guy, very talented man, very talented man. He was a musical genius. Also he played to play dirty hearts. Most of the time we would go to rehearsal to play hearts. It was Syd Catlett again, Tyree Glenn, trumpet player who died, Red -- New Orleans.

Red Allen, yeah. And we would play dirty hearts, or sometimes rehearsal would start three hours late, we'd start playing hearts. But very memorable times. Most of the guys are dead now. Let's see, Tyree's dead, isn't he. Yeah. Red. Yeah. And yeah, we recorded during that time with -- I think it was during -- no, this was after. I'm getting confused because I worked with him before the war, this is when we did those things with Billie Holiday -- with Don Redman and the band. This is when they had Don Biase and Roy…
